title: GET computer reports host_start_generation after computer-queue nack
description: HTTP honesty after 8dbdc1: when the computer queue worker records a host start before nacking, GET /users/{id}/computer must expose host_start_generation >= 1. Kernel-only; no Fargate RunTask; does not close 23c93e (live deploy still required for CloudFront).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Kernel on origin/develop @ 3b2adc3. HTTP Gherkin and pytest prove GET /users/{id}/computer reports host_start_generation 1 after computer-queue nack and after Front Door recycle. Live pin 19070b1 still omits the field; 23c93e stays open until ThinTurn redeploy.
